newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Steffi Graf leaves Melbourne after dad found guilty.
newsitem.headline: Steffi Graf leaves Melbourne after dad found guilty.

text.p: Germany's world number one tennis star Steffi Graf flew out of the Australian city of Melbourne on Friday after her father was sentenced to a jail term for tax evasion.
Graf lost in the fourth round of the Australian Open last Sunday and has since rested in Melbourne after suffering from an infected toe and heat exhaustion.
Along with other women's tennis stars, Graf boarded a flight to Japan via Sydney. She is due to play in a tournament starting in Tokyo on Tuesday.
But she declined to reply to reporters' questions, saying angrily: "Haven't you guys got enough?"
Graf's father Peter, 58, was sentenced in the German town of Mannheim to three years and nine months' jail after being convicted of six charges of tax evasion.

Peter Graf was said to have avoided paying tax on millions of dollars of his daughter's tennis earnings. It was unclear whether he would have to spend any time in jail since he has already spent more than a year in prison awaiting trial.
